questions.scientific_question: Which candidate genes belong to independently selected, frozen gene sets after species, identifier and collection reconciliation?
required_endpoint_stages: Resolve resource, collection and exact set identifier; expose conflicts between the name and descriptive collection instead of silently guessing.
Normalize every candidate within the correct species and release, retaining ambiguous and unmapped identifiers.
Join complete candidate-to-set membership and evidence, retaining duplicates and missing-data dispositions.
observed_input_requirements: An independent selection of published gene sets in native GMT or resource export, species-specific gene identifier mappings, set metadata and redistribution permission. Preserve observed-study or curated-annotation provenance.
proposed_artifact_requirements: candidate_membership.tsv: query_id, set_id, candidate_id, resolved_gene_id, species, mapping_status, membership_status, source_record_id
set_manifest.tsv: set_id, resource, release, collection, biological_context, source_accession, checksum
source_specific_decisions: Set identity overrides neither conflicting collection metadata nor species; resolve those conflicts before authoring.
Define exact membership versus ontology-descendant membership, synonym ambiguity, duplicate normalization and whether the supplied export is complete for each requested set.
deterministic_verification_approach: Parse native GMT with the pinned reference package and independently recompute full set membership and identifier joins. Compare all candidates, not only the selected gene.
questions.evaluation_contract: Require every named artifact and every candidate identity, including unresolved cases. Compare the complete frozen-resource query result under the stated method; do not grade only a selected label.
questions.source_protocol_limits: The source asks for resource membership, not de novo differential expression, enrichment or factorization. Twelve records span curated mouse phenotype sets and study-derived signatures; one family-level card does not make their biological contexts equivalent.

required_incorrect_output_checks: Map a mouse symbol to a human gene without an explicit orthology step.
Drop an unmapped candidate or use a similarly named set from a different collection.
Treat an absent row in an incomplete export as a confirmed nonmember.

endpoint_contract_review.runtime_boundary: Frozen bounded exports; measure native reference and solver runtime before asserting the 30-minute limit.

questions.scientific_question: Which independently observed protein changes have matching ClinVar assertions after sequence, accession, condition and review-status reconciliation?
required_endpoint_stages: Identify protein accession and isoform from supplied sequence evidence and preserve nonunique matches.
For sequence inputs, align each candidate against its resolved reference and enumerate every difference; for residue-change inputs, verify reference residue and position.
Join all compatible nucleotide/variation records without inventing a unique DNA allele from a protein substitution.
Report assertion type, condition, review status, conflicts and unresolved matches before applying an explicit lookup rule.
observed_input_requirements: Independent observed variant records, versioned protein FASTA and transcript cross-references, plus a frozen ClinVar export retaining aggregate and submitted assertions. Do not manufacture alternate sequences and label them observed.
required_formats: ClinVar native XML or documented tabular export
proposed_artifact_requirements: sequence_identity.tsv: candidate_id, reference_accession_version, alignment_span, identity_status
protein_changes.tsv: candidate_id, reference_accession_version, position, reference_residue, alternate_residue, ambiguity_status
assertions.tsv: candidate_id, protein_change_id, variation_id, allele_id, accession_version, record_level, condition_id, classification_type, classification, review_status, evaluated_date
candidate_results.tsv: candidate_id, match_count, requested_class, supported_class, conflict_status, disposition
source_specific_decisions: Separate residue-change input (8 source records) from complete candidate-protein input (7); a shared task must exercise both input modes or claim only the matching subset.
Fix transcript/isoform resolution, alignment ambiguity, classification type, condition scope and aggregation policy. Do not rank review stars as probabilities of pathogenicity.
Allow unresolved and conflicting evidence; distinguish a missing assertion from benign classification.
deterministic_verification_approach: Use a pinned native sequence parser/alignment package and independent residue-coordinate checks. Verify every candidate-to-assertion join against the frozen input, preserving one-to-many mappings and all specified conflicts.
questions.evaluation_contract: Require every named artifact and every candidate identity, including unresolved cases. Compare the complete frozen-resource query result under the stated method; do not grade only a selected label.
questions.source_protocol_limits: This is reproducible retrieval of recorded classifications, not an independent prediction of clinical pathogenicity. Native VCF normalization alone misses the source sequence-identification endpoint. Source answer labels and protein sequences are not authoring inputs.

questions.scientific_question: Which candidate promoters overlap independently selected binding-site records under strand-aware TSS coordinates and frozen annotation rules?
required_endpoint_stages: Resolve the queried binding factor, candidate genes, assembly and annotation release.
Enumerate eligible transcript TSSs and construct the requested upstream/downstream window in strand-relative coordinates.
Intersect the specified site or cluster track, preserving each transcript, site, assay and overlap length.
Aggregate to candidate genes only under the declared any-transcript or selected-transcript rule.
observed_input_requirements: Matching assembly GTF/GFF, independently selected binding-site BED records, assay/cluster provenance and the same-version gene/protein identifier map.
proposed_artifact_requirements: promoters.bed: transcript-keyed windows with gene and strand
overlaps.tsv: candidate_gene_id, transcript_id, binding_factor_id, site_id, assay_id, overlap_bp
candidate_results.tsv: candidate_gene_id, eligible_transcripts, matched_sites, status
source_specific_decisions: The seven source questions specify -1000,+100 around TSS. Freeze whether endpoints are inclusive, BED conversion, chromosome clipping and transcript selection.
Select the GTRD release and actual track type; a motif match, individual peak and merged cluster are distinct evidence.
Do not silently substitute a new live annotation or guess a factor from an ambiguous symbol.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run bedtools or GenomicRanges on native intervals; independently enumerate overlap arithmetic and strand-relative boundaries. Compare all promoters and site joins, not only positive genes.
questions.evaluation_contract: Require every named artifact and every candidate identity, including unresolved cases. Compare the complete frozen-resource query result under the stated method; do not grade only a selected label.
questions.source_protocol_limits: A recorded promoter overlap is not proof of regulation or a condition-specific effect. GTRD track schemas and permitted independent inputs still need inspection; current review covers all seven source question stems, not the biological records.
